title: Exercise Library Locale Overlay
description: One file per non-fallback locale (content/i18n/<locale>.yml). Merged into the master document's i18n maps by scripts/library_locales.py before validation and sync; the fallback locale lives in the master file itself.

locale.description: Locale code; must match the filename stem and appear in the master `locales` list.

exercises.description: Map: exercise slug (master map key) -> localized entry.

instructions.description: Markdown content; keep the master entry's section structure.

fallback_to.description: If a field is missing in this entry, read it from this locale (read-only fallback). Example: en_CA -> en.

validated.description: True once a human has reviewed this locale's copy; false marks machine-authored copy the client labels as such.

source_digest.description: source_digest() of the fallback-locale name+instructions this translation was made from; a mismatch marks the translation stale in the coverage report. Stripped during merge, never synced.
